ai_summary.text:
ストライクはM&A仲介の大手企業。中堅・中小企業のM&A仲介を主力に、事業承継・企業再編のアドバイザリーサービスを提供している。AIマッチングシステムを活用した効率的な案件創出が特徴。

売上203億円（前年比+12%）と二桁増収。営業利益63億円（営業利益率31.2%）、純利益47億円。M&A仲介の31%超の営業利益率は、成約報酬型モデルの高い収益性を反映。ROE22%と極めて高い資本効率。

自己資本比率86.7%、財務健全性スコア100点と最高評価の財務。営業CF38億円、FCF35億円とほぼ全額がFCFとして残る。EPS246円に対しPER18倍、配当180円で配当性向は約73%。中小企業の後継者不在率は60%を超えており、事業承継M&Aの需要は構造的に拡大し続けている。なお、EPS245.8円、PER18.0倍、1株当たり配当金180.0円の水準にあり、株主還元と企業価値の向上を両立させる経営を推進している
ai_summary.text_en: Strike saw a double-digit increase in sales to  20.3 billion (up 12% year-on-year). Operating profit was  6.3 billion (operating margin of 31.2%) and net profit was  4.7 billion. The operating margin of over 31% for M&A brokerage reflects the high profitability of the success-based compensation model. ROE was an extremely high 22%, indicating extremely high capital efficiency.  The equity ratio was 86.7% and the financial soundness score was 100 points, the highest rating for finances. Operating CF was  3.8 billion and FCF was  3.5 billion, with almost all of it remaining as FCF. EPS was  246, with a PER of 18x, and a dividend of  180, with a dividend payout ratio of approximately 73%. The shortage of successors at small and medium-sized enterprises exceeds 60%, and the demand for business succession M&A continues to structurally expand. Furthermore, with EPS at  245.8, a PER of 18.0x, and a dividend per share of  180.0, the company is promoting management that balances shareholder returns with corporate value enhancement.
